subject: Request: Open backfill req + interview schedule governance
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Open backfill req + interview schedule governance

Team —

We need a greenlight to open a backfill req for the Platform infra engineer (REQ-1379) following Rahul's promotion. I put together a short operational approach and a proposed interview cadence so we can get the loop closed in ~3 weeks if we move quickly.

Quick ask:
- Can leadership approve opening the req and the hiring-slot (headcount is available under Platform FY27 budget)?
- Can recruiting start outreach with the two active candidates we discussed & confirm panel availability next week?

Attached: req_spec_v3.docx and a draft panel_availability_matrix.xlsx that Priyom seeded.

Proposed interview flow (high level):
1) Recruiter screen (30m) — Priyom
2) Technical screen (45m) — panel of 2 (Aditya + one eng)
3) Systems design (1h) — Laura + rotating senior engineer
4) Final onsite debrief + hiring manager decision (30m) — Laura + Hiring Ops (Kim)

If we need to tighten the loop, I can approve a one-week compressed schedule (day 0 screen -> day 7 final) but I want ops/availability constraints flagged now.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Open backfill req + interview schedule governance

Mateo —

Thanks for pulling this together. I support opening REQ-1379 and agree the FY27 slot covers it. Two requests before recruiting runs:
- Please add a short paragraph to the req_spec (1–2 lines) describing the on-call expectations (pager rotation cadence). I want candidates aware up front.
- For the systems design round, include a perf/latency focused prompt — we need to check for relevant experience with batching/caching patterns.

Scheduling: I prefer the 10–14 day window but am OK with a compressed one-week track for first-pass candidates if Ops confirms panel availability. If compressed, let's reserve both 09:00 and 14:00 slots for the week of May 10–14.

Go ahead from my side once the above two bullets are added and Priyom confirms candidate availability.

Laura Bennett
VP Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference

Team —

I uploaded the resume for the top candidate (attached: candidate_resume_jane_doe.pdf) and updated the availability matrix. Sanjay from ACME is looped in to coordinate passive outreach for the second pipeline candidate.

Notes:
- Candidate Jane Doe is available May 11–13 mornings (PT).
- She has strong distributed systems experience and a couple of notes on batching/kv-cache in her resume — good match for the perf prompt.
- I've added a recruiter screen on May 10 (tentative) and blocked 45m for Aditya for the tech screen on May 11 at 9am PT.

Attachments: candidate_resume_jane_doe.pdf, panel_availability_matrix.xlsx

Priyom Das

Subject: Re: Request: Open backfill req + interview schedule governance

Folks —

Operational clarifications before I greenlight bookings:
- Panel composition: please confirm the secondary engineer for the technical screen. Aditya is primary — we should pick an alternate (suggest: Markus or Rishi).
- Debrief cadence: I recommend a 30m debrief immediately after final interview with a brief scoring template (I will post the doc link to the req page).
- Offer authority & timeline: Laura, confirm if you want to allow verbal offers same-day for strong fits (we will process paperwork next day).

If Priyom confirms Jane's slots and we get the on-call paragraph into req_spec_v3.docx, we can book rooms and calendar invites today.

Attachment stub: req_spec_v3.docx (please include on-call line)

Kimberly Park

Thanks for the context. I approve opening the req and confirming the hire slot. Budget is cleared under Platform FY27.

Two quick asks:
- Please include me in the final hiring packet (condensed score + reference checks) but only loop me into the debrief if the candidate is tabled for offer. No need to pull me into every scheduling thread.
- If we pursue the compressed schedule, ensure hiring ops confirms availability for offer approvals the following business day.
